claims.evidence: Witness only reports a purple/black steam iron with labels that appear to include 'STEAM' and 'SMART'; no brand/model or specs shown.
No photo/clip shows it being switched on, heating, producing steam, or not leaking.
No warranty/guarantee document is shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: No receipt/warranty card or internal/motor condition evidence is shown; only the exterior is described.
Witness report does not include photos of the receipt or warranty card.

risks.risk: Not actually working (no heat/weak steam) or leaks water while steaming; exterior photos can’t confirm performance.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the iron switched on, reaching heat, continuous steam output, and no leaking/dripping from the soleplate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used steam iron with unknown working condition (worst case: not reliably steaming).

risks.risk: Limescale buildup causing weak steam, sputtering, or clogging; not visible unless descaled/inside is checked.
risks.proof: A clip of steaming after filling with water, plus a photo of the water tank/steam vents; ideally a quick flush/descale proof.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially descaled/dirty internally (worst case: needs descaling).

risks.risk: Soleplate damage (scratches/rust/warping) affecting ironing quality; witness report doesn’t mention soleplate condition.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the entire soleplate surface (including tip/edges) in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically worn with possible soleplate wear.

risks.risk: Electrical safety issues (cord insulation wear, plug faults, loose connection) not confirmed by a single visible cord shot.
risks.proof: Photos of the full cord length (especially near plug and where it enters the iron) and a close-up of the plug pins; plus a brief power-on test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown electrical safety (worst case: cord/plug may need replacement).

risks.risk: Voltage/plug mismatch with Abuja supply (e.g., wrong rating), which can cause poor performance or damage.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating label showing voltage (e.g., 220–240V) and plug type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown voltage (worst case: may not be suitable for Abuja).

risks.risk: Brand/model uncertainty prevents matching to typical market value and features (industrial vs standard).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand and exact model from the label/ratings plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used steam iron without confirmed industrial specs.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the brand and exact model (and the full rating/voltage label).
Send a short video showing it switched on: heating up, steady steam output, and no leaking/dripping.
Send close-up photos of the soleplate (tip, edges, and entire surface) in bright light.
Send photos of the full cord length, especially near the plug and where it enters the iron; include a close-up of the plug.
Show the receipt and warranty card/guarantee document (photo of dates/terms).
Show evidence of descaling/clean water tank condition, or a clip after descaling/flush.
response.reason: The item type is clear (steam iron), but key value drivers—working condition, steam performance, soleplate condition, voltage rating, and warranty proof—are not shown. Without those, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
